items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: Well I can't go, well Johnny go, Tom go, he'll go.

ctx.x: But outside I'd rather pick a band. The same man doing things like, no, I want you. That's good. But a silly band, a bunch of man, you get together. I like the way you work, I like the way you work, I like the way you work. I want you all the way together. I like the way you work. Get together and we have a band together. Yeah, man, that's all right. All right, I'll manage you. Where they'll put you sister man? Where you take that? I asked that boy, say, ring on. Say, sit and sit the sink, go sit and sit the…
Well, every job is paying off your, what you call paying off your, you pay your man off day, so much for your manager part. But today they don't call manager part.
